title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Regional Road Corridor Improvement Project (Supplementary)

description.narrative: The principal objectives of the project are to reduce transport costs and foster regional cooperation among PRC, Tajikistan and other Central Asian countries. The road will increase regional traffice and trade, improve access to regional markets and social services for people living along the Corridor.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved access to markets and social services

Travel time between Sary Tash and Karamik reduced from 4 hours in 2009 to 2.5 hours by end-2012 (1.5 hour or 90 minutes time saving) Progress/Status: The travel time between Sary-Tash and Karamyk reduced from 4 hours to about 2 hours in 2013. Data Source: National economic and social statistics, Annual Monitoring Reports of MOTC Actual value:

Daily international freight traffic on the project road increases from about 10 trucks per day in 2006 to 120 trucks per day in 2015 Progress/Status: The daily international freight traffic on the project road was about 50 trucks in 2013 (AADT). Data Source: National economic and social statistics, Annual Monitoring Reports of MOTC Actual value:

Agricultural, horticultural, and livestock production in the project area increases from 100,000 tons in 2006 to 160,000 tons in 2015. Progress/Status: The agriculture production increased from 59,725 ton in 2007 to 76,110 ton in 2013. The total cattle in the project area was 138,086 head in 2012. Data Source: National economic and social statistics, Annual Monitoring Reports of MOTC Actual value:

Traffic accidents on the Corridor reduces from 14 accidents per 250 AADT in 2006 to 14 per 750 AADT in 2015 Progress/Status: In 2013, total 19 road accidents on the project road with 7 deaths and 21 injured. The accident rate was 14 accidents per 288 AADT. Data Source: National economic and social statistics, Annual Monitoring Reports of MOTC Actual value:

Domestic traffic on the project road increases from 250 AADT in 2006 to 750 AADT in 2015 Progress/Status: Domestic traffic on the project road increased to 310 vehicles (AADT) in 2013. Data Source: National economic and social statistics, Actual value:

Number of children in the project area attending secondary school increases from 95% in 2007 to 99% in 2015 Progress/Status: The overall student attendance rate increased to 94.2% in 2013 comparing with 92.1% in 2007. Data Source: National economic and social statistics, Annual Monitoring Reports of MOTC Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Indicator Indicator: By 2013, 136 km section with two-layer asphalt concrete pavement (under supplementary financing) completed Progress/Status: Achievement to be assessed in 2013 Data Source: Annual monitoring reports of MOTC, and Project Peroformance Monitoring Reports Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Road Maintenance Improvement: Pilot cases of outsourcing road maintenance for Kyrgyzstan introduced, with 5 contracts awarded to private sector by 2013 Progress/Status: Achievement to be assessed in 2013 Data Source: Annual monitoring reports of MOTC, and Project Peroformance Monitoring Reports Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Border infrastructure improved and adequate procedures in place by end-2012 Progress/Status: Border facility improvement component experiences a long delay due to the price escalation and shortage of the government's budgetary allocations. Data Source: Annual monitoring reports of MOTC, and Project Peroformance Monitoring Reports Baseline year: 2008 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2008 Baseline value: N Target year: 2012 Target value: Y

Output: Indicator Indicator: By 2010, 263 kilometers of main regional corridor, including 24 bridges improved. Progress/Status: The road improvement contract has been completed Data Source: Annual monitoring reports of MOTC, and Project Peroformance Monitoring Reports Baseline year: 2008 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2008 Baseline value: N Target year: 2010 Target value: Y

Output: Indicator Indicator: Cross-border agreement signed and effective by end-2012 Progress/Status: Signed by Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan in December 2010 and became effective on 28 June 2011. Data Source: Annual monitoring reports of MOTC, and Project Peroformance Monitoring Reports Baseline year: 2008 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2008 Baseline value: N Target year: 2012 Target value: Y
